function setup() {
  createCanvas(400, 400, WEBGL);
  brush.scaleBrushes(2); // scales brush (nearby brushes are 2x bigger)
  noLoop(); // exit loop after starting
}

function draw() {
  translate(-width / 2, -height / 2); // uses our perspective to make hills 2/3 larger
  background("#f4efe4");
  noStroke();
  // sun
  brush.fill("#66c"); // purples + yellow shades
  brush.circle(160, 100, 50); // golden sun
  brush.fill("#e08a72"); // palette - green provides shadow
  brush.circle(200, 100, 30); // green sun
  brush.fill("#008000"); // green shadow
  brush.circle(200, 100, 20); // green shadow on hills
  // ground
  brush.fill("#008000"); // hills green
  brush.fillTexture(20, 10); // slope where shallows
  brush.vertex(200, 10); // bottom edge of hills
  brush.vertex(160, 140); // middle of hill
  brush.vertex(200, 180); // middle of hill
  brush.endShape(true); // end hills shape
  brush.fill("#408040"); // mature green
  brush.circle(200, 150, 150); // hills
  brush.fill("#406020"); // green after sunrise
  brush.circle(200, 150, 100); // hills
  brush.fill("#00a040"); // noonday green
  brush.circle(200, 150, 40); // hills
  brush.fillTexture(20, 10); // slope on hills
  brush.vertex(160, 140); // middle of hill
  brush.vertex(175, 140); // middle of hill
  brush.vertex(200, 140); // middle of hill
  brush.endShape(true); // end hills shape
}
